person.name: Stephen Skinner

born.provenance: wikipedia-weak (uncited in article body; matches self-reported bio)

nationality.value: Australian; long-resident in London (1972–2003, and again from 2021 per Wikipedia), Malaysia (2003–2010) and Singapore (2010–c.2021)

person.status: Living. Every characterisation below is sourced or labelled; disputes reported as positions, never adjudicated.

undergraduate.value: BA, University of Sydney (1965–1968), majoring in English Literature and Geography with Philosophy (Greek philosophy and formal logic)

earlyCareer.value: Geography master, St Joseph's College Hunters Hill (1970); geography lecturer, Sydney Technical College — the institution his bios call 'now the University of Technology, Sydney' (1971–72)

doctorate.institution: University of Newcastle, NSW, Australia (School of Humanities and Social Science per Wikipedia)
doctorate.thesisTitle: Magical techniques and implements present in Graeco-Egyptian magical papyri, Byzantine Greek Solomonic manuscripts and European grimoires: transmission, continuity and commonality (the technology of Solomonic magic)
doctorate.thesisYear: 2013 (thesis dated; Wikipedia states the degree was awarded 2014)
doctorate.repositoryRecord: https://openresearch.newcastle.edu.au/articles/thesis/.../29020349 (also indexed at oatd.org, record handle:1959.13/1041669; legacy URL ogma.newcastle.edu.au/vital/access/manager/Repository/uon:13943)
doctorate.subject: Transmission, continuity and commonality of magical techniques and implements from the Graeco-Egyptian magical papyri via the Byzantine Greek Solomonic manuscripts (Hygromanteia / Magical Treatise of Solomon) to the Latin and English Solomonic grimoires (Clavicula Salomonis family)
doctorate.provenance: verified-independent — the thesis EXISTS in the University of Newcastle repository under this title and handle. The gloss 'PhD in Classics' is SELF-REPORTED (sskinner.com); the repository listing found does not itself name the discipline. Award-year discrepancy (2013 thesis date vs 2014 award per Wikipedia) unresolved.

honours.value: First Westerner titled 'Grand Master of Feng Shui' by the International Feng Shui Association (Singapore); helped found the IFSA in 2004
honours.provenance: self-reported / wikipedia-weak (IFSA founding carries a Wikipedia cite)

honours.value: Listed in 'The 100 Most Spiritually Influential People Living in 2022', Watkins Mind Body Spirit issue 68 (Jan 2022)

publishingOperations.name: Underground magazines Lucifer and Chaos, Sydney
Askin Publishers Ltd, London
publishingOperations.note: Printed editions of classic magical texts: Aleister Crowley's Astrology (1974), Lapidus's In Pursuit of Gold (1976), Laycock's Complete Enochian Dictionary (1978), Agrippa and Paracelsus items later reissued by Ibis. Also credited (Wikipedia, cited) with arranging re-photography of the Thoth tarot paintings at the Warburg Institute for the 1976 card pack.
publishingOperations.provenance: self-reported + wikipedia-weak; the Askin imprint books themselves are independently verifiable in the trade

publishingOperations.name: 1990s London consumer-magazine publishing (Wining and Dining, Healthy Living, Alternatives, XL)
Feng Shui for Modern Living (magazine)
publishingOperations.note: Claimed audited circulation 121,000+ monthly at peak (self-reported); nominated for PPA Publisher of the Year 2000 (Wikipedia, cited).

publishingOperations.name: Golden Hoard Press
publishingOperations.role: founder/proprietor; principal imprint for the Sourceworks of Ceremonial Magic series and his classical feng shui titles
publishingOperations.dates: imprint active from 2004 (London); GOLDEN HOARD PRESS PTE. LTD. incorporated Singapore 2008-12-03, UEN 200822581C, status live
publishingOperations.provenance: company registration verified-independent (companies.sg / sgpbusiness.com); founding narrative self-reported/wikipedia-weak. bibliography.note: Roles: AUTHORED (original monograph), EDITED (edition/transcription/introduction of a historical text), TRANSLATED, COMPILATION. Golden Hoard first editions given where established by bookseller/first-edition records; Wikipedia and sskinner.com sometimes date a volume by its later Llewellyn edition — flagged where caught. Contents are described at operative-graph level only (procedure type, structural anatomy, completeness); no operative text.

geomancy.title: Terrestrial Astrology: Divination by Geomancy
geomancy.editions: Routledge & Kegan Paul, London 1980, 8vo, pp. xiii+293 (ISBN 0-7100-0553-9)
geomancy.reception: Reviewed in Medical History (Cambridge); the review and the book's continued citation make it his most academically visible work. His own site lists the publisher as 'Law Book' (the Sydney distributor); the imprint is RKP — verified by the Cambridge review head-matter and the ISBN prefix.

geomancy.title: The Oracle of Geomancy: Techniques of Earth Divination
geomancy.editions: Prism, Devon 1987 (ISBN 978-0907061823); Golden Hoard reissue 2021. An earlier 1977 printing is sometimes listed in the trade — UNVERIFIED here.

geomancy.title: Geomancy in Theory and Practice
geomancy.role: AUTHORED (revised and retitled successor of Terrestrial Astrology)
geomancy.editions: Llewellyn 2010 (ISBN 978-0738723501); Golden Hoard 2011 (978-0-9557387-0-8); further Golden Hoard printing 2020 per his site

sourceworksOfCeremonialMagic.seriesNote: Golden Hoard Press series of edited manuscript grimoires, most with later Llewellyn trade editions. Vols I–VI produced with David Rankine 2004–2010 (publisher's own framing); series resumed 2018 with Daniel Clark. All are EDITED transcriptions/translations of named manuscripts with substantial introductions — not authored monographs.

volumes.title: The Practical Angel Magic of Dr John Dee's Enochian Tables
volumes.contents: Transcription of a 17th-century manuscript reworking of Dee's angel-magic tables (British Library Sloane MSS); procedure type: angel-invocation system; completeness: edition of a complete compilation.

volumes.title: The Keys to the Gateway of Magic: Summoning the Solomonic Archangels and Demon Princes
volumes.contents: Transcription of Janua Magica Reserata, Dr Rudd's Nine Hierarchies of Angels and Nine Celestial Keys; procedure type: hierarchical invocation.

volumes.title: The Goetia of Dr Rudd: Liber Malorum Spirituum seu Goetia
volumes.contents: Edition of Rudd's British Library manuscript of the Lemegeton: Goetia, Theurgia-Goetia, Ars Paulina 1–2, Ars Almadel, with a study of 17th-century evocation technique. NOTE: Wikipedia and sskinner.com date this 2009 — that is a later edition; first-edition records say 2007.

volumes.title: The Veritable Key of Solomon
volumes.contents: First English translation of Wellcome MS 4669 and MS 4670 (French, 1796), three-part Key of Solomon; material outside the Mathers 1889 recension. NOTE: Wikipedia/sskinner date 2011 = later edition.

volumes.title: The Grimoire of Saint Cyprian: Clavis Inferni
volumes.contents: Edition/translation of Wellcome MS 2000 (Cyprianus, M.L.), a late Latin/cipher grimoire; procedure type: demon-king invocation at the cardinal points.

volumes.title: Sepher Raziel, also known as Liber Salomonis: A 1564 English Grimoire
volumes.contents: Transcription of the 1564 English Sloane MS 3826 Liber Salomonis; procedure type: planetary/astral text with seven-book anatomy.

volumes.title: Liber Lunae — The Book of the Moon
volumes.with: ed. Don Karr, trans. Calanit Nachshon
volumes.contents: Lunar mansion magic and related Hebrew material (Sefer ha-Levanah); procedure type: lunar-mansion elections/talismanry.

volumes.title: The Magical Treatise of Solomon, or Hygromanteia
volumes.contents: First full English translation of the Byzantine Greek Hygromanteia manuscripts — the missing-link text of his PhD argument; procedure anatomy: planetary hours, implements, spirit lists.

volumes.title: A Cunning Man's Grimoire: The Secret of Secrets
volumes.contents: Edition of Wellcome MS 3203, an English cunning-man's working book.

volumes.title: The Clavis or Key to Unlock the Mysteries of Magic of Rabbi Solomon, translated by Ebenezer Sibley
volumes.contents: Edition of the Sibley/Hockley Clavis manuscript tradition of the Key of Solomon in English.

volumes.title: Ars Notoria: The Grimoire of Rapid Learning by Magic (Version A)
volumes.with: Daniel Clark; incorporates Robert Turner's 1657 translation
volumes.contents: Version A of the Ars Notoria with the Turner 1657 English text; procedure type: notae-based memory/learning orations.

volumes.title: Ars Notoria: The Method (Version B)
volumes.contents: Version B, the Opus Operum recension; presented by the publisher as the methodical completion of Vol. XI.

volumes.title: The Steganographia of Johannes Trithemius, Books I–IV
volumes.contents: Translated, edited and introduced; cryptography/spirit-communication treatise.

volumes.title: Antipalus Maleficiorum (Trithemius)
volumes.contents: Trithemius's catalogue of magical books and counter-witchcraft treatise.

volumes.title: Summa Sacre Magice of Berengar Ganell, Books 1 & 2
volumes.contents: First English edition of the largest medieval magic compendium.

volumes.title: Summa Sacre Magice, Books 3 & 4
volumes.contents: sskinner.com labels this 'Vol. 18' while Amazon labels the set 'Vol. XV series' — series numbering for 2025 volumes is inconsistent across sources and left unresolved.
